chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan, and Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Do not touch anything of the perfume, nor of the oils, while in your state of Ihram; and beware of the perfume in your food; and restrain your nose from the pleasant scent, and do not hold it back from the foul smell, for it is not fitting for the one in Ihram to take pleasure in a pleasant scent.

key_terms.إِحْرَام: Ihram (the sacred state of consecration for Hajj or Umrah)
key_terms.مُحْرِم: The one in the state of Ihram

ai.seo_question: What are the rules regarding the use and consumption of perfume while in the state of Ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the prohibition of using perfume in all forms—topical, culinary, or olfactory—for a pilgrim in Ihram, emphasizing the removal of sensory pleasure as a key spiritual discipline. Notably, it distinguishes between avoiding pleasant scents and tolerating foul odors, reflecting the juristic principle that the restriction is on luxury and comfort rather than general hygiene. This ruling underscores the state of Ihram as one of simplicity and detachment from worldly adornments.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan and Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> who said, ‘

You can neither touch anything from the perfumes, nor from the oils while being in your Ihraam; and fear the perfume in your meals, restrain your nose from the aromas of perfumes, and do not hold it from the fetid smell, for it is not befitting for the one in Ihraam that he indulges in pleasures with aromas of perfumes’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr and Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il from al-Fadf ibn Shadhan from Safwan and ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

You must not touch any perfume or oil in the state of Ihram. Avoid perfumes in your food, hold your nose from sweet smelling things but you must not hold your nose against bad smells; it is not proper for one in the state of Ihram to enjoy sweet smelling perfumes.”’
